messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — SPA v3 (our counter)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

v3 attached (tracked against your v2). We've moved to: cap £10.625m (25% of EV); basket £510,000; claims period 21 months; Geoffrey's covenant back to 30 months (Patricia at 24 accepted). On Wexbourne, we've added a specific indemnity pending the change-of-control consent rather than adjusting price. I think this is close — shall we aim to agree the remaining points on a call Thursday?

James
